name: executive_summary
title: Executive summary / briefing
description: Short briefing for senior readers: the answer first (situation, complication, resolution), the evidence behind it, and the decision or next step.
storyline: SCQA: situation, complication, question, answer — the answer goes on the first content slide. Keep body text to about 30 words a slide.

slots.title: <The answer as one sentence>
slots.guidance: Situation, complication, answer, in 3-4 lines with the key numbers.

slots.title: <The fact that proves the answer>
slots.guidance: One chart per supporting fact; source and period on each.

slots.title: <What we recommend and what it achieves>
slots.guidance: The recommendation, its cost and its payoff.

slots.title: Next steps: who does what by when
slots.guidance: Columns Action | Owner | Due. One row per commitment; a named owner and a date on every row.
